notes.title: New update
notes.content:
Kr! The chickens has been waiting for a new update!

Interface changes:
-The minimap is now working correct.
-Fixed the size of the text.
-Correction in the store's interface.

Changes in the balance:
-The damage absorption coefficient of chicken body armors has been increased.

Game changes:
-The chicken now holds the gun a little differently, which looks more pretentious and brutal.
-A new music track has been added, it start just in time for the appearance of the final boss and the final waves of enemies. Cheerful and epic!

Bugfixes:
-Now the cursor with the image of reloading while reloading the weapon is displayed correctly.
-Changes in the code responsible for shooting, now there are no nasty "lags" when shooting.
-The kick from the leg (chicken paw) now always works good and the animation works fine.
